🟢 Welcome to +1 Slime Escape

How to Play:
⏫ Hold Jump to charge your leap and tap jump again to cancel early
👟 Airtime will make you jump higher
🏆 Overcome obstacles to get wins
💪 Unlock new upgrades
🔥 Rebirth to push your limits
⏰ Earn Rewards offline

Active Codes:
- Release
- World1
- PlaytimeRewards
- Racing

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
If you’re having fun, don't forget to like the game! 👍
